description: This source file defines a static class 'DriverFactory' responsible for creating and managing WebDriver instances for different browsers in Selenium-based UI automation tests. It contains methods for initializing and quitting the driver, with configurations for Chrome, Firefox, and Edge including options for headless operation and binary location.

classes.name: DriverFactory
classes.description: A static class that provides methods to create and manage WebDriver instances for different browsers, supporting headless operation and custom binary paths.

methods.name: Driver
methods.description: A static property that returns the current IWebDriver instance or throws if not initialized.

methods.name: CreateDriver
methods.description: Initializes the WebDriver based on the configured browser type, setting appropriate options and timeouts.

methods.name: QuitDriver
methods.description: Quits and disposes of the current WebDriver instance if it exists.
